title: RosterSnapshot (ROSTER-v1, v1.0) — signed atomic roster snapshot per MLS epoch
description: F-12: the entity's SIGNED manifest of its complete scope roster at one MLS epoch — what makes the member enumeration ATOMIC and historically verifiable. Sealed by the entity's wallet-administration key (the same authority that seals BW-MEMBER/ORG; directory-pinned, X-01). COMPLETENESS IS WHAT THE SIGNATURE ATTESTS: the members[] list is the entire active roster of (uid, scope, epoch) — no pagination of the signed set; each member_doc_digest pins the EXACT sealed BW-MEMBER version in force, so an omitted active member or a mixed-version enumeration is detectable (LINT-DISC-26). tree_hash MUST equal the ratchet-tree hash inside the retained GroupContext the evidence mls_state commits to (F-03) — the snapshot chains enumeration ↔ tree ↔ evidence. Served current and as-of under the evidence-retention duty (EDD contract v1.9.0).

member_doc_digest.description: SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of the sealed BW-MEMBER's dCBOR body — pins the EXACT document version in force at this epoch.

tree_hash.description: The epoch's ratchet-tree hash (lowercase hex) — MUST equal the tree hash inside the retained GroupContext committed by the evidence mls_state (F-03/D3).
